[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Bachelor of Science in Engineering Management","groupId":"101d1f73-ce9d-4b33-92dd-0195917cf8a3","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must complete a minimum of 120 units of academic work and a minimum of 32 units of Cooperative Education in order to earn the Bachelor of Science in engineering management.

","groupId":"e98a395c-4d54-4f06-a965-0195917cf8a4","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"General Education Requirements","groupId":"b91e0b67-5b0c-4fde-ac70-0195917d99fb","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

For more details, see General Education

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include the following requirements.

","groupId":"c0d32a01-e28e-40bf-a381-0195917d99fb","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"CORE Requirements","groupId":"3ef80d24-2f6e-458c-8e8d-0195917e6a6b","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit.

2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.

","groupId":"1c7233f0-d302-4182-94e0-0195917e6a6b","position":5,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Breadth Requirement (7 courses, at least 3 units each)","groupId":"033452af-4d4e-4330-bcf6-0195917ee41c","position":6,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Note: No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.

","groupId":"c659d29d-4a5c-4942-9000-0195917ee41c","position":7,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Diversity and Inclusion Requirement","groupId":"8d342e08-735b-4021-b15c-0195917fd5cf","position":8,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Note:  Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.

","groupId":"923bba51-7151-4c67-80e2-0195917fd5cf","position":9,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Fundamental Skills","groupId":"1c5b76ca-9acf-4f7c-a2a0-019591804edf","position":10,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note:  Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

","groupId":"36a57770-01a8-42aa-a2a4-019591804ee0","position":11,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Major Requirements","groupId":"4135ec43-b23d-4ba0-8366-019591837d33","position":12,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) Students who transfer in with 28 or more units are exempt from taking IDEA 010 and IDEA 020.

2) Each student works with their advisor to develop a customized set of Engineering Discipline electives to meet student specific goals and objectives as necessary to fulfill the 45-engineering unit minimum. The Engineering Management website describes potential sets of electives for different career paths.

3) Two additional math/science electives above MATH 057.

4) Two Engineering Science electives with minimum 6 units.

5) Two BUSI/EMGT electives.
